background: User on Mac (cmux over SSH, Korean 2-set IME) pressed Ctrl-] then ㅇ expecting detach (d). The Mac IME holds a lone jamo in preedit and sends it only on commit (usually the user then presses Space or Enter, so the bytes arrive as 'ㅇ ' or 'ㅇ\r', possibly split across reads and possibly seconds after the prefix). User decision: convert the jamo automatically to its 2-set QWERTY key; commit with Space.
required_behavior: Standard 2-set (dubeolsik) table, compatibility jamo -> key: ㅂq ㅈw ㄷe ㄱr ㅅt ㅛy ㅕu ㅑi ㅐo ㅔp ㅁa ㄴs ㅇd ㄹf ㅎg ㅗh ㅓj ㅏk ㅣl ㅋz ㅌx ㅊc ㅍv ㅠb ㅜn ㅡm ㅃQ ㅉW ㄸE ㄲR ㅆT ㅒO ㅖP. Keep it as one module-level table in src/workbench/ui/product/input.py (or model.py) with a short comment.

Prefix command context: when the key after the prefix is exactly ONE mapped compatibility jamo (the whole non-ASCII run is that single character, UTF-8 possibly split across reads), run the command of the mapped ASCII key exactly as if that key had been typed (e.g. ㅇ->d detach, ㅋ->z zoom, ㅅ->t, ㅊ->c, ㅗ->h, ㄱ->r, ㅡ->m; unmapped results behave like any unknown command key). The single IME commit key right after it (Space, CR/LF, Tab, C0 per the existing rule) is still swallowed, so 'ㅇ ' detaches and the Space opens no menu and reaches no pane.
The prefix state must stay armed until the jamo arrives however long it takes (the IME may hold it for seconds); verify there is no timeout that drops it.
Scroll mode (prefix [): the same conversion applies to its letter keys (ㅓ->j, ㅏ->k, ㅎ->g, shift has no jamo for G so only g, ㅂ->q), with the following commit key swallowed.

Unchanged: Hangul syllables or multi-character runs after the prefix keep the hint + swallow; Hangul while the command menu is open is swallowed; Hangul without the prefix reaches the pane unchanged; Ctrl aliases, prefix Space menu, pastes and mouse unchanged.

Hint/help text: update HANGUL_HINT and the help overlay line so they state the new usage briefly in Korean, e.g. '한글 입력 상태: Ctrl-] 뒤 자모 + Space (예: ㅇ Space = d), Ctrl 조합(Ctrl-] Ctrl-d), Ctrl-] Space 메뉴'. Keep within existing width handling.
acceptance: red->green tests in tests/ui/test_product_model.py: prefix+ㅇ+Space / +CR / split UTF-8 / arriving 5 s later -> detach (quit) with nothing forwarded; prefix+ㅋ -> zoom; prefix+ㅆ (T) behaves like T; scroll mode ㅓ/ㅏ/ㅂ; prefix+'안' still hint only; Hangul without prefix unchanged

update your own tests in tests/ui/test_product_model.py and tests/ui/test_product_pty.py that asserted the old 'jamo after prefix is never a command' behaviour; add one PTY test: real loop, prefix + 'ㅇ ' detaches with exit 0

All other tests/ui test_*.py, tests/contracts and tests/gates/g1_vt (PYTHONPATH=src:.) must pass.
